business_summary: MarketEnterprise Co.,Ltd engages in the online reuse, mobile communications, and other businesses in Japan. The company buys and sells reused goods via the internet; and offers buyback and sales services; and reuse of agricultural machinery. It also built and operates its buying websites for various products, including daily necessities and hobby goods, agricultural and construction equipment, medical devices, and other products for corporate clients. In addition, the company provides Oikura, reuse platform for bulk appraisal service; and wireless internet connection service under the Kashimo WiMAX name. Further, it operates Beginners, a media platform that supports people who want to find a hobby or start something new and different; Cheapest Repair.com, a repair service provider information platform; Airz, a motor lifestyle information media outlet; and Motorz Jp Channel/Motorz Channel for car enthusiasts. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
